title: Paris-based digital health insurance startup Alan raised €100M led by Index Ventures at a €5B valuation, up from €4B after raising €173M in September 2024 (Anna Heim/TechCrunch)
summary: Anna Heim / TechCrunch: Paris-based digital health insurance startup Alan raised €100M led by Index Ventures at a €5B valuation, up from €4B after raising €173M in September 2024 — 30% of European unicorns may have lost their billion-dollar status, but not Alan.
contentText:
Anna Heim / TechCrunch :

Paris-based digital health insurance startup Alan raised €100M led by Index Ventures at a €5B valuation, up from €4B after raising €173M in September 2024   —  30% of European unicorns may have lost their billion-dollar status, but not Alan.
